time_expression.qualification: This section is a scene specification to be consumed by the new Notebook/limited adapter; it is not an already implemented aidata API or a new production data contract.

query_mode.label: 所选K当时可知的结果
query_mode.allowed_Ks: Only the pinned cuts listed above; do not advertise an arbitrary-K reader from sparse exports.
query_mode.axis_notice: 单K图按本切点取范围；不同选择的屏幕高度不直接表示数值可比。

comparison_mode.label: 事后并列所列切点；每个值仍为其原K可知结果
comparison_mode.primary_geometry: Separate points or paired selected-cut diagrams, with same-scale numeric comparison within each declared coordinate. Keep the selected-K query view available.
comparison_mode.price_context: Use the existing selected-cut price view and bounded time annotations; do not construct a new charting platform.
comparison_mode.shared_numeric_range: Use the finite values of the explicitly compared cuts and existing nominal_range/identity capability; label this as retrospective comparison. Do not leak later-cut axis bounds or notes into the separate as-known query mode.
comparison_mode.missing: No numeric substitute; display a state/reason label at the relevant cut, preserving formal present/knownness/applicability/reason.

rb.primary_price_end: selected_K for query; confirmation_K for retrospective pair
required_expressions: At the confirmation cut, mark actual start/end separately from confirmation/known_from; new knowledge is not a new market start.
Keep recent and previous completed-window efficiency separate; identify the newly admitted member, recent-to-previous member, and exiting previous member by actual Life and source order.
Annotate changed membership only in the retrospective comparison or at a cut where it is already known; never place the newly completed member into the before-confirmation as-known view.
Show the new working Life, its actual start and formal age together; do not interpret direction change or the changed counter value as a same-process improvement.

At the later reference, distinguish same working Life from changed storage address; show waiting and formal denominator alongside the ratio. Endpoint equality of a statistic is not proof it held throughout the interval.

geometry.member_encoding: Use existing boundary styles and limited labels/markers for the three changed roles, not new state colors or a general categorical plotting subsystem.
geometry.scalar_comparison: Focused before/confirmation pair; keep the distant final reference separate or selectable so it does not compress the confirmation pair.
geometry.identity_detail: Human-readable short Life in the graphic, full Life/revision and original fields in hover or compact supporting data.

i.price_end: selected_K in query; last compared K in explicitly retrospective comparison
required_expressions: Keep the whole working start/Life/age visible separately from local_start and waiting.

Preserve a local-clock explanation after the zero waiting cut when local_start is present and last_update is still absent; do not label a positive waiting value as time since a known extreme in this state.
Distinguish restored endpoint progress from still missing path efficiency/counter and missing rhythm denominator at each cut.
Show source natural timestamps as well as CalendarUTITick; the overnight observation gap is not 600 natural seconds or proof of missing market trading.
Never add a price mark at the whole-process start when its source price was not supplied. An off-screen/input-coverage text anchor is allowed, not a fabricated price.

geometry.clock_comparison: Separate whole-process age and local waiting readouts; actual observed points with no connecting/holding line across the supplied cuts.
geometry.state_encoding: Readable per-cut missingness labels and actual zero markers. Use shapes, positions and words, not extra colors for status.

revision_and_coverage.additional_OnlyRead: Only for a specifically identified missing relation or a necessary interval/correction claim. First reuse existing raw cuts. No blanket 433-occurrence archive or recomputation.

validation_focus: Re-use the existing same-price/different-K renderer evidence; do not relabel it as completed browser interaction.
Actually switch rb before-confirmation -> confirmation -> before-confirmation and verify that later members/annotations do not persist.
Actually switch i missing-before-recovery -> recovery -> after-recovery -> earlier cut, checking local versus whole age and persistent missing fields.
Inspect the new time/member annotations, comparison axes and per-cut missingness with real pixels; name the actual operator.
Use exact raw members, working values/bases/rhythm and source prices, not hardcoded historical numbers or plot_view_data as formal data.
Deliver an actually executed .ipynb, consumed configuration and source/graph linkage; uploading this plan alone is not display completion.

scope.current_work: Work1/2 temporal identity and display intelligibility, not formal Work4
